insight.headline: Set product categories on custom line items in draft orders and order edits
insight.what_changed: Starting with GraphQL Admin API version 2027-01, you can assign a category from Shopify's Standard Product Taxonomy to custom line items in draft orders and order edits. The category controls the item's tax treatment in the same way it does for products. For stores using Managed Taxes, the product category is the only input that sets a custom line item's tax treatment. What's new You can now set a…
